thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: p99 latency burn in eu-central for inference-service (route: /v1/generate). Page fired.
Sam B: acked. looking into dashboards now. any customer visible errors reported?
Priya K: saw a spike in p99 from ~300ms -> 2.1s starting ~10m ago. no 5xxs in the logs but a lot of tokenizer queue backlog in the worker-metrics view.
Jared L: checking autoscaler events — pods scaled up but there was a gap of ~60s before new instances joined. can share the events.
Sam B: reposting relevant logs snippet: ```kubernetes: evict: pod restart delay=63s, autoscaler: provision_request queued, kvcache_misses=high```
Priya K: also seeing a huge bump in KV cache miss rate for model-42 (recent rollout). prefix cache hitrate dropped from 92% -> 26%.
Sam B: hypothesis: model rollout + cold KV cache causing tokenization + backend prefetch thrash -> long tail. customers with long-prefix prompts hit it hardest.
pagerduty: pd-incident-note: severity=high, impacted_routes=["/v1/generate"], region=eu-central.
Jared L: can we flip traffic to the compatible quantized variant (model-42-q4f) temporarily? That one has warmed cache and lower memory footprint.
Priya K: we can. routing change: ```curl -X POST https://console.internal/routing/swap -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"model-42-q4f"}'``` — but need ops signoff for immediate swap.
Sam B: +1 for rollback of the model rollout instead of swap. rollback command: `deployctl rollback model-42 --to model-41` — quicker and preserves routing metrics.
Jared L: rollback might be better to stop the thrash if model-42 has regressed cache patterns. who triggered rollout earlier? I can see the deployment user id in CI logs.
Priya K: while we decide, we should also scale up dedicated pool for eu to reduce provisioning gap. autoscaler policy currently set to 2->6 with cooldown 45s; propose temporary override to 8 and cooldown 10s.
Sam B: doing scale override now: ```/override-autoscaler eu-central 8 10s #temp```
incident-bot: action logged: autoscaler override applied by Sam B. previous target=6 new-target=8 expiry=00:30:00.
Jared L: creating a quick canary rollback: ```deployctl rollback model-42 --to model-41 --canary 30%``` to watch tail before full rollback.
Priya K: good call. setting canary 30% now.
Sam B: metrics: p99 in eu-central dipping to 1.2s after scale override but still above SLO. prefix cache warming in progress, hitrate up to 48%.
Jared L: can we enable aggressive KV prefetch for the canary instances? small config patch: ```kvcache.prefetch.enabled=true; kvcache.prefetch.window=2048``` — will push more memory but should reduce misses.
Priya K: enabling prefetch on canary only. patch applied.
incident-bot: note: pd-ack by Sam B at 4071239999. escalation not required at present.
Ops Night: I'm on the overlap shift for next hour — happy to take handoff once we stabilize. leave a runbook pointer please.
Sam B: leaving notes: runbook link https://internal/runbooks/latency-eu-kv-cache. mitigations applied: autoscaler override, canary rollback, kv prefetch on canary. monitor p99 for next 10m.
Jared L: observed tail improvement to 0.9s on canary traffic, full region still ~1.0-1.2s. no customer-facing 5xx. recommend full rollback to model-41.
Priya K: rolling back to model-41 at 30m mark. command executed: `deployctl rollback model-42 --to model-41 --confirm`.
Sam B: rollback completed. kicking a cache warm job to prepopulate prefixes: ```kubectl exec -n infra prefiller -- /app/prefill --model model-41 --region eu-central --ttl 3600 &``` 
incident-bot: update: autoscaler override will expire in 25m unless extended.
Sam B: monitoring — p99 now stabilized ~380ms, p95 ~120ms. marking incident as mitigated; leaving for Ops Night to watch and close after 1h stable.
Ops Night: I'll monitor for the hour and extend override if needed. any customer comms required?
Priya K: support queue shows 4 tickets mentioning sluggish responses in the last 15m, no escalations to enterprise sales. recommend a brief note to impacted customers: include apology + mitigation summary.
Sam B: draft for comms: "We've identified increased latency on eu-central earlier today due to a model rollout interacting with cache warmup. We rolled back the model and performed cache warmup; services are stable. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." please review.
Jared L: lgtm. add a link to the runbook and mention no data loss.
Sam B: comms posted to status page. incident-bot: incident state -> mitigated, mitigation_notes added.
incident-bot: summary: mitigation actions = [autoscaler override, rollback to model-41, kv prefetch on canary, cache prefill job]. probable root cause = model-42 cache-warmup profile + autoscaler cooldown gap. follow-ups = adjust rollout canary traffic ramp, add automated cache warmup hooks in deployment pipeline, reduce autoscaler cooldown for eu region.
Ops Night: taking the monitoring handoff. I'll update thread after 1h. good job team :thumbsup:
Sam B: thanks everyone. closing the PD incident per runbook in 30m if stable.
